jp: 夕飯[ゆうはん]{の|no-possessive}準備[じゅんび]中[ちゅう]、猫[ねこ]{に|passive-agent}魚[さかな]{を|passive-suffering}食[た]べられました。
en: While I was preparing dinner, the cat ate my fish on me.
why: The affected owner has the fish taken or eaten on them, and the thing affected stays marked with を in this suffering passive.

en: My older sister took my favourite umbrella without asking, and I was upset.

why: The note that was thrown away is the affected object, marked with を even though the sentence is passive.
